issues.description: Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience: the problem statement and the template declare the property monthsOfSwiftExperience as Int? but the solution implementation declares it as Double?. This inconsistency appears both on the stored property and on the initializer parameter (template and problem expect Int?; solution uses Double?). This mismatch is structural and will confuse students about the intended type to use, how to implement the initializer, how to increment the value in attend(course:), and how to use a switch that checks for value 1. It may cause students to implement code using Int arithmetic and pattern matching while the reference solution uses Double, leading to unexpected differences in examples and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type consistent across all artifacts. Preferred minimal fix: change the solution to use Int? for Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience and change the solution initializer signature to init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?). Update any code in the solution that manipulates the property (swiftExperienceDescription switch, attend(course:) increment) to use Int arithmetic and comparisons. Alternatively, if Double? is intentional, update the problem statement and template to specify Double? and adjust examples and tests accordingly.
